analyst_view.overall: Early view: Real Sociedad drew 1-1 with Lyon and sit 20th with five points, so a home win over Torreense matters. Torreense beat Ararat-Armenia 3-2 with two stoppage-time goals despite playing most of the game with ten men after Jorge Aguirre's red card, and will be without him here.

goals.text: The numbers say 4.3 goals, which looks high. Real Sociedad scored once from 11 shots against Lyon, and while Torreense concede chances, a total above four needs a lot to go right for the home side.

corners.text: The numbers say 11.1 corners. Real Sociedad took five corners against Lyon, but a deep-sitting Torreense side at Anoeta should give them more; I stay with the number.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.4 cards. Real Sociedad picked up three yellows against Lyon, and Torreense's game with Ararat had a red card and eight yellows, so the high figure is supported.

shots.text: The numbers say 31.3 shots. I lean slightly lower: Real Sociedad took only 11 shots against Lyon, and Torreense's last game had 31 shots mostly because Ararat had an extra man for over an hour.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.1 shots on target. Torreense's game had 13 on target in total, though helped by the man advantage; nothing else points clearly either way.
